title: Ministry of Ayush Reports Significant Progress under Special Campaign 6.0
subtitle: Ayush Ministry disposes of 368 public grievances and 64 appeals; 285 cleanliness campaigns conducted
body_text: The Ministry of Ayush has made significant progress under Special Campaign 6.0, with a strong focus on timely grievance redressal, efficient record management and cleanliness across its offices. During the campaign, the Ministry disposed of 368 public grievances and 64 public grievance appeals, reaffirming its commitment to responsive, transparent and citizen-centric governance. Additionally, 7 references from Members of Parliament and 4 references from the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) were addressed, reflecting the Ministry’s emphasis on timely and effective grievance redressal. As part of the campaign, the Ministry conducted 285 cleanliness campaigns, aimed at improving workplace cleanliness, promoting a hygienic working environment and making better use of office space. In the area of record management, 1,610 files were reviewed, weeded out and closed. Through the disposal of scrap and obsolete records, a total of 8,741 square feet of space was freed, making it available for more productive use. The Ministry also earned ₹1,94,161 in revenue through scrap disposal, reflecting its efforts towards better resource management and improved administrative efficiency. The Ministry of Ayush continues to implement Special Campaign 6.0 with an emphasis on the timely disposal of pending grievances and appeals, systematic record management, cleanliness and effective use of government resources. Through these initiatives, the Ministry aims to build a cleaner, more organised and citizen-centric working environment. *** SR/SV/SG
